evidence: CVE.org record https://cveawg.mitre.org/api/cve/CVE-2026-77640 is state=PUBLISHED (not rejected/withdrawn). It describes TROVE-2026-021: a truncated zlib/gzip stream finalized with done=1 never reaches Z_STREAM_END, zlib returns Z_BUF_ERROR with no input remaining, and buf_add_compress() treats that as a full output buffer and retries forever. CWE-1284, CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:L.

Pre-fix src/lib/compress/compress_zlib.c in tor_zlib_compress_process maps Z_BUF_ERROR with avail_in==0 && !finish to TOR_COMPRESS_OK, then falls through to TOR_COMPRESS_BUFFER_FULL. That fall-through is taken when finish==1 and avail_in==0.

Pre-fix and tor-0.4.9.8 src/lib/compress/compress_buf.c buf_add_compress() loops do...while(!over). TOR_COMPRESS_BUFFER_FULL allocates a new chunk when avail remains and only sets over when data_len==0 && !done, so a no-progress finalize never terminates. That is an infinite allocation/retry denial of service, not a withdrawn advisory.

Independent pickaxe of the surviving causal condition `avail_in == 0 && !finish` on src/common/torgzip.c / src/common/compress_zlib.c / src/lib/compress/compress_zlib.c first hits 7573e66b9961cdb571c3c7af688fd01912e66455 (author Nick Mathewson, 2014-06-03 / committed 2014-09-03), subject 'Treat Z_BUF_ERROR as TOR_ZLIB_BUF_FULL when finalizing a zlib buffer'.

findings: CVE-2026-77640 / GHSA-5g6h-2vr8-m7f4 / TROVE-2026-021 is a real published infinite-loop DoS: truncated zlib/gzip finalize (done/finish=1) yields Z_BUF_ERROR with avail_in==0; Tor maps that to BUFFER_FULL; buf_add_compress()/write_to_buf_zlib() allocate and retry forever.

Smallest public first-write is 7573e66b9961cdb571c3c7af688fd01912e66455, which added `&& !finish` so no-input finalization became TOR_ZLIB_BUF_FULL. Immediate parent ad8977e39461807dd04e34dc7fa3c12ccef0b62d returned TOR_ZLIB_OK for all avail_in==0 Z_BUF_ERROR and therefore lacked the hang.
The retry sink already existed at the BIC (write_to_buf_zlib in src/or/buffers.c) and remains at tor-0.4.9.8 in buf_add_compress(). Later compress module splits/renames are not BICs.
